issues.problem: Context 6 (有关部门不能总是打太极) is about a department evading residents; 踢皮球 (gy100, departments passing a problem around) fits the braces just as well.
issues.action: Rewrote it around one official who keeps dodging questions without answering: 那位局长一直在{打太极}，始终不肯正面回答。

issues.problem: Context 5 makes the 杀手锏 a person (a fast striker sent on as a substitute), where 王牌 is the more natural word and fits just as well; this also blurs the card's own near-note.
issues.action: Rewrote it as a decisive move held back until the last game: 他才用上{杀手锏}：一种对手从没见过的发球。

issues.problem: Story says he robs the convoy 'with a sworn brother'. In 说唐 his partner in robbing the tribute silver is 尤俊达, and I cannot confirm they were sworn brothers at that point.
issues.action: Cut the detail: he lies in wait on the road and robs a convoy carrying tribute silver to the court. The rest of the story is kept (a real early-Tang general, a lucky comic hero of the storytelling tradition).

issues.problem: none: the abacus rule (to add 3 when there are not enough lower beads: push down the five-bead and take away two) is correct.
none: Guan Yu escorting Liu Bei's wives through five passes and killing six generals is chapter 27 of 三国演义, and the card rightly says the episode is fiction.
The story is null. A folk tale about Lu Ban and an apprentice named 泰山 is sometimes told, but it is not well enough attested.
